LanguageData.PathogenicFluDetectedDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed symptoms of the pathogenic flu!\n\nThe disease has progressed from its incubation phase. Ensure the colonist receives medical attention.
LanguageData.DP_PathogenicFluDetectedDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed symptoms of the pathogenic flu!\n\nThe disease has progressed from its incubation phase. Ensure the colonist receives medical attention.
LanguageData.DP_TransmissionWarning: Warning: The disease is contagious! Anyone in close proximity may be exposed.
LanguageData.DP_PathogenicFluRecoveredDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has recovered from the pathogenic flu.
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_Enable_Desc: Enable the standalone respiratory disease simulation with hidden disease state tracking. When disabled, both hidden progression and visible Pathogenics severity progression pause until re-enabled.
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_AffectColonistsOnly_Des: If enabled, only colonists can be affected by the disease simulation.
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_EnableOutsiderImportati: When enabled, outsiders (visitors, traders, raiders, refugees, prisoners, quest pawns) can bring the disease into the colony.
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_EnableRespiratorySpread: When enabled, infectious pawns can transmit the disease to nearby pawns in the same room.
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_ShowTransmissionWarning: When a colonist develops symptoms, show a warning about disease transmission risk.
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_ShowDebugReadout_Desc: Display an on-screen overlay showing disease state for all pawns (useful for balancing).
LanguageData.Dyze_Pathogenics_DebugLogging_Desc: If enabled, the mod writes extra diagnostic messages to the RimWorld log.
